sentences.en: The daily life can be busy, hectic and sometimes overwhelming.
sentences.zh: 日常生活的压力可能很大，忙碌且有时会让人感到无法承受。

sentences.en: Fadil received an overwhelming amount of feedback about his video.
sentences.zh: 法迪尔收到了关于他视频的大量反馈。

sentences.en: Her desire for self-righteousness overwhelms the rest of her personality.
sentences.zh: 她那股自以为是的情绪压倒了其他个性特质。

senses.zh: 淹没：cover；（感情上、精神上）使无所适从，使难以忍受：
